full_judgment: 8. Now the question is whether the power of the Magistrate under section 250B which was not in existence when the order discharging the accused persons was passed relates to a substantive right and a beneficial privilege of the accused under law, or whether the repealing provision is procedural in nature or it gives substantive right to the accused petitioners. While answering these question the learned Advocate for the parties have referred to the decisions reported in 20 D.L.R. (SC) page 315, 21 D.L.R.(SC) Page 123 and A.I.R. 1950 East Punjab (F.B) 25.
